experiment_data.hypothesis: Fast-DetectGPT (Mitchell et al. 2023) perturbation discrepancy scores, when calibrated to 4-class ordinal depth via equal-width/CORAL/threshold methods, achieve near-chance accuracy on full 9-cell atlas. Extends detectgpt_ordinal_baseline_002 (8/9 cells, 29.1%) to include pythia_nucleus. Confirms perturbation-based binary detection lacks ordinal resolution.

reproduce.command: bash -c "source /root/miniconda3/etc/profile.d/conda.sh && conda activate base && export HF_HOME=/root/autodl-tmp/.hf_cache && export HF_ENDPOINT=https://hf-mirror.com && cd /root/autodl-tmp/recursive_gen_depth_est && python scripts/detectgpt_baseline_v2.py"

experiment_data.notes: 失败原因: pythia_nucleus 数据路径不存在 (/root/autodl-tmp/recursive_gen_depth_est/data/pythia_nucleus/depth_{0-3}.jsonl)，脚本在处理第 9/9 cell 时崩溃 (TypeError: np.bincount float64→int64)。前 8 个 cell 均成功执行（结果在 log 中）。| 已有成果: 8/9 cells 完成，与 parent (detectgpt_ordinal_baseline_002) 覆盖范围相同 | 建议: 查 pythia_nucleus 实际数据路径，修复脚本目录映射后重跑
